text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx + gateway timeouts detected for customer 'Thunderbolt' on Dedicated cluster ded-thunderbolt-1. Error rate 502/504 spike at 18:21 UTC. Paging oncall-sre and infra.

maria: seeing a sharp jump in 502s and a tail of timeouts. Dashboard: https://console.internal/redwood/dedicated/ded-thunderbolt-1/errors (shared)

aj: looking. Metrics: cpu utilization on host pool at 96%, queue length growing, a few OOM kill traces on worker-3.

kevin: noisy neighbor possibility — tenant rabbit-cache-3 is doing long-running batched requests per logs. Should we evict?

diana: customer impact report: about ~12% of requests for Thunderbolt are getting 5xx/timeouts in last 5m. Higher for long-context endpoints.

oncall-sre: ack, I'm on it. Starting by pinning traffic to fallback model variant and opening a mitigation runbook. Can someone grab evict permissions? I'll start throttles.

aj: i'll triage host metrics and check whether autoscaler is blocked. Running:
```
kubectl get pods -n ded-thunderbolt -o wide | grep crash
kubectl top nodes | sort -r -k3
```

maria: FYI the routing policy shows requests are routed to model v2-large with seq len >= 1024 which is heavy. We can route to v2-medium temporarily (less mem) — do we have a compatible fallback? :eyes:

kevin: yes, we have v2-medium and a quantized variant. Fallback config flag: /configs/ded-thunderbolt/fallbacks.json

diana: customer comms: thunderbolt-contact@thunderbolt.com, CS notified. They reported timeouts ~18:20 UTC. Will draft an incident email if we escalate.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-18512. Severity: P1-customer. Linked runbook: https://wiki.internal/incidents/ded-noisy-neighbor

aj: logs show repeated "kv-cache miss + long serialization" lines from rabbit-cache-3 task queue. Sample:
```
2026-03-14T18:19:45Z worker-3 rpc_handler.go:124 timeout waiting for kv response (2000ms)
2026-03-14T18:19:46Z worker-3 runtime.go:501 eviction triggered for tenant rabbit-cache-3
```

oncall-sre: action plan (short): 1) apply routing fallback to v2-medium (instant) 2) throttle tenant rabbit-cache-3 (limit QPS) 3) if persists, evict rabbit-cache-3 from pool and reschedule to burst capacity 4) scale up pool if autoscaler blocked.

maria: i'm applying fallback now: `POST /api/v1/configs/ded-thunderbolt/route` with body routing->v2-medium. Pasting curl response: `200 OK - route updated`.

kevin: i'm preparing an eviction for rabbit-cache-3. Evict will cause some retries for that tenant but relieve pressure.

diana: please @mention me when you reach step 3 so I can call the Thunderbolt SRE contact before eviction.

aj: autoscaler shows pending node launches failing due to capacity in region. There's a cloud API quota hiccup. Requesting manual burst via infra console.

oncall-sre: if we can't get nodes, evicting noisy tenant is higher priority. Kevin, proceed with a graceful eviction (drain then move tasks).

kevin: initiating eviction: `./tools/evict-tenant --cluster ded-thunderbolt-1 --tenant rabbit-cache-3 --grace 60s` -> kicked off.

incident-bot: eviction job started: job-8721. Monitor: https://console.internal/jobs/job-8721

maria: after routing fallback, overall 5xx rate dropped from 12% to 6% over 2m. Latency p50 improved a bit. Still seeing tail at 504 for long contexts.

aj: eviction logs show tasks draining, a few retries, CPU pressure decreasing on worker-3. Node memory freed up.

diana: customer notified (first ping): "We're investigating increased timeouts. Mitigation in progress; will update in 30m." Sent to thunderbolt-contact@thunderbolt.com

oncall-sre: monitoring for 10m. If errors <1% we can close P1 and open a follow-up for autoscaler quotas and tenancy isolation.

kevin: eviction completed, tenant moved to dedicated burst pool ded-burst-2. Worker metrics look stable.

maria: 5xx now ~0.9% over 5m window. p99 latency still slightly elevated for very long requests but overall service restored.

aj: created follow-up tickets: INFRA-1248 (cloud quota), PLAT-882 (better tenancy isolation / preemptive throttles). Linking to INC-2026-18512.

diana: preparing incident summary and CS postmortem. Will ask for timeline + action items. Assigning owners: infra for quota (aj), platform for throttles (kevin), ops for routing defaults (maria).

oncall-sre: handing off to morning oncall in 12m. Leaving notes in the incident doc. If anyone sees regression ping me.

maria: leaving a small config change suggestion in PR: reduce default long-context route to v2-medium for dedicated customers with >50% long seq mix. PR: https://git.internal/repo/123

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-18512 moving to MONITORING. Close conditions: sustained <1% 5xx for 30m and no customer errors reported.

diana: final customer update drafted and sent. Will attach postmortem when ready.

pagerduty: PagerDuty note: oncall-sre acknowledged, incident resolved to monitoring.

maria: thanks everyone. tagging owners for follow-ups.

kevin: thumbs. :thumbsup:

oncall-sre: signing off from active. Good job team.
